% Run the installed legend image code and report the resulting PGF picture bounds.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\probe}[3]{\begin{tikzpicture}[#2]
  \pgfplotsset{#3}
  \pgfkeysvalueof{/pgfplots/legend image code/.@cmd}{blue,fill=blue!30}\pgfeov
  \typeout{IMAGE #1: \the\pgf@picminx,\the\pgf@picminy,\the\pgf@picmaxx,\the\pgf@picmaxy}
\end{tikzpicture}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\probe{area}{}{area legend}
\probe{group-y}{ybar}{ybar legend}
\probe{group-x}{xbar}{xbar legend}
\probe{single-y}{ybar}{single ybar legend}
\probe{single-x}{xbar}{single xbar legend}
\probe{interval-y}{ybar interval}{ybar interval legend}
\probe{interval-x}{xbar interval}{xbar interval legend}
\probe{interval-single}{ybar interval}{single ybar legend}
\end{document}
